//: Fixture profiles, from the manufacturers' sheets in ../content. Sizes in metres.

gm-par-rgbw-7x10.name: GM Light LED PAR RGBW IP65 7x10
gm-par-rgbw-7x10.//mode: Resolume pixel-maps colour, so 4ch RGBW is the one to use; 8ch adds a master dimmer and strobe you would have to drive some other way.

showtec-pixelbar-18-q4.name: Showtec Pixel Bar 18 Q4 Tour (41302)
showtec-pixelbar-18-q4.//mode: 72ch gives each of the 18 LEDs its own RGBW, which is what pixel mapping in Resolume wants. 6ch treats the whole bar as one colour.

led-bar-12-rgbwauv.name: LED pixel bar 12 × RGBWA+UV
led-bar-12-rgbwauv.source: the bars on site (2026-10-06): 12 segments of R,G,B,W,A,UV, channel order confirmed by Sil; model unknown
led-bar-12-rgbwauv.//mode: 72ch gives each of the 12 segments its own RGBWA+UV, in that order (confirmed). Resolume pixel-maps them as RGBWA (5 ch, the UV channel of each segment left at 0). Body size and beam are placeholders until the model is known.
